model.title: Crystal Reservoir Conveyance Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Michael Bennet (D-CO)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Secretary of Agriculture to transfer ownership of certain Forest Service land and a reservoir to the City of Ouray, Colorado.
